notes_history.supervisor_note: D204 drove solo all day; no second driver.

deciding.driver_attributed: Trip cards and the tacho card are D204, but tacho_summary lists second_driver D377 on shift with no times. The supervisor note says no second driver, which contradicts the tacho, so attribution is only modestly favoured.
deciding.follow_up: The breach is confirmed and there is no prior coaching. The stint of about 5.7 h and the roughly 21% excess make it serious enough for formal review, but the lack of any history leaves coaching defensible.
deciding.worst_event_cause: The speed event has empty tags, there are no limit_updates, the device health flags are empty and the map is current, so nothing external explains it.
deciding.speed_excess: 85 mph in a 70 limit is 21.4% over. That is only just past the 20% line, so level 3 versus level 2 is open, and the second-driver question adds doubt.
deciding.hours_exposure: Trips 07:00-09:40 and 10:00-12:40 have a 20 minute gap, and tacho drive runs 07:00-12:40 with no 45 minute break. That gives about 5.67 h, just over 5.5, and a possible unlogged changeover keeps level 2 plausible.
